summary.en: Numbers round a huge dial sweep 96° and stop dead; the answer at the top flies down to become the first figure of the title while the others blur away.
summary.zh: 巨大纸面表盘上的一圈数字扫过 96° 后急停，停在弧顶的那个数字飞下来成为标题的首字，其余数字原地失焦散去。

fits: A small number that is the claim, reached by sweeping down from bigger ones (5 min to install, 2 steps, 1 click): a countdown that resolves into the title.
notFor: Numbers without a scale (an id, a version); dark grounds (the dial is tuned for paper and its blur greys on dark); more than once a film (it is a hard stop).

intent.en: The number is shown inside a range, sweeping from many down to few, so it argues for itself; then the same figure becomes the title.
intent.zh: 把数字放进一段量程里，从很多一路扫到很少，数字自己就是论证；停下后同一个数字变成标题。

content.en: 5–9 numbers of the same kind (≤ 3 chars each) with the answer among them, and the rest of the title after the figure (≤ 16 chars).
content.zh: 5–9 个同类数字（每个 ≤ 3 字符），答案在其中；再给数字后面的标题部分（≤ 6 字）。

fits.zh: 一个本身就是主张的小数字，由更大的数一路扫下来得到（5 分钟装好、2 步、1 次点击）：倒计时收成标题。

notFor.zh: 没有量程的数字（编号、版本号）；深色底（表盘按纸面调的，失焦在深底上发灰）；一支片用两次以上（它是急停）。

en: Numbers on the dial must share one size and weight; mixed sizes read as a chart, not a dial.
The answer must stop exactly at the top of the arc; changing the list changes which index lands there.
The stop and the landing are a few frames apart: give them two different short sounds, or they blur into one.
zh: 盘面数字必须等大同字重，大小不一就读成数据图而不是表盘。
答案必须正好停在弧顶；改了数列就要重新核对哪一个落在那里。
扫停和落位只隔几帧：配两记不同音色的短音，同音连发会糊成一声。

upstream.name: 表盘数字扫过
upstream.summary: 纸面表盘 9 个等大数字沿大弧切向排布，整盘扫过 96° 后减速急停，"5" 停在弧顶随即平移落位成标题首字符，其余数字带 blur 原地散去，标题逐词模糊淡入、末词转强调色
upstream.use: 倒计时/时长承诺类文案（"5 min to install"）；数据揭晓的一拍；需要"仪表盘"语汇的浅底短镜
upstream.energy: 高（96° 大幅扫动压进 ~20 帧，纯冲击）

overlaps.note: roulette-lock laps a row of candidates with a frame and locks on the answer; dial-sweep turns a dial of numbers and the answer becomes the title
